author: Zephyr I
title: Replicate: Bottleneck-dilated d=5 (ratio=0.60, SiLU) — BASE_SEED=7
abstract: Replication of fine-sweep best config: d=5 bottleneck-dilated CNN + single-step LN-ConvLSTM with bottleneck_ratio=0.60 and SiLU activation. Fixed hparams to verify stability under BASE_SEED=7.

original_submission.content:
import sys
sys.path.append('storage/zephyr')
from networks.cnn_convlstm_layernorm_single_step_dilated_bottleneck import DilatedBottleneckSotaNet
from ray import tune

BASE_SEED = 7

def _define_hyperparameters():
    return {
        'learning_rate': tune.choice([4e-4]),
        'entropy_coef': tune.choice([0.01]),
        'value_loss_coef': tune.choice([0.5]),
        'cnn_features_1': tune.choice([32]),
        'cnn_features_2': tune.choice([64]),
        'conv_lstm_features': tune.choice([64]),
        'bottleneck_ratio': tune.choice([0.60]),
        'use_silu': tune.choice([True]),
    }

def create_network(hparams):
    return DilatedBottleneckSotaNet(
        cnn_features_1=32,
        cnn_features_2=64,
        conv_lstm_features=64,
        dilation=5,
        bottleneck_ratio=0.60,
        use_silu=True,
    )
